text_en: At 4-6 days post-hatching, the expression levels of casp10 and bax genes in the intestines of mandarin fish larvae in the Artemia group were significantly higher than those in the silver carp larvae group, suggesting that feeding on Artemia may lead to programmed cell death of intestinal epithelial cells.

quote:
本研究比较了营
养强化卤虫与鲢仔鱼作为开口饵料的效果, 卤虫组
鳜仔鱼的体重和全长均低于鲢仔鱼组, 生长受到一
定抑制。
statement: 营养强化卤虫组鳜仔鱼的体重和全长均低于鲢仔鱼组，表明其生长受到一定抑制。
text_zh: 营养强化卤虫组鳜仔鱼的体重和全长均低于鲢仔鱼组，表明其生长受到一定抑制。
text_en: The weight and total length of mandarin fish fry in the nutritionally enriched Artemia group were lower than those in the silver carp fry group, indicating that their growth was inhibited to some extent.

quote:
本文猜测可能是由于营养强化后的卤虫,
其营养成分仍难以满足鳜开口期所需的营养, 尤其
是在对蛋白质和必需脂肪酸需求量较高的关键窗
口期(3—6 dph)。
statement: 推测营养强化卤虫的营养成分难以满足鳜仔鱼在3-6日龄关键窗口期对蛋白质和必需脂肪酸的高需求。
text_zh: 推测营养强化卤虫的营养成分难以满足鳜仔鱼在3-6日龄关键窗口期对蛋白质和必需脂肪酸的高需求。
text_en: It is speculated that the nutritional composition of nutritionally enriched Artemia may be difficult to meet the high demand for protein and essential fatty acids in juvenile mandarin fish during the critical window period of 3-6 days post-hatching.

quote:
其他研究也认
为卤虫的脂肪酸组成及游离氨基酸含量与饵料鱼
仍存在些许差距
[26—28]。
statement: 其他研究认为卤虫的脂肪酸组成及游离氨基酸含量与饵料鱼相比存在差距。
text_zh: 其他研究认为卤虫的脂肪酸组成及游离氨基酸含量与饵料鱼相比存在差距。
text_en: Other studies suggest that the fatty acid composition and free amino acid content of Artemia differ from those of bait fish.
intervention: Artemia vs silver carp fry as first feed
intervention_record: 卤虫与鲢仔鱼开口饵料对比

quote:
进一步分析3—9 dph的SGR
也发现, 卤虫组在各时间段均低于鲢仔鱼组, 尤其
在3—6 dph阶段差异显著, 在7—9 dph阶段, 卤虫组
SGR较前期有所回升, 并逐渐接近鲢仔鱼组, 可能
与恢复投喂鲢仔鱼有关。
statement: 卤虫组在3-9日龄期间的特定生长率(SGR)均低于鲢仔鱼组，尤其在3-6日龄差异显著；7-9日龄时卤虫组SGR回升并接近鲢仔鱼组，可能与恢复投喂鲢仔鱼有关。
text_zh: 卤虫组在3-9日龄期间的特定生长率(SGR)均低于鲢仔鱼组，尤其在3-6日龄差异显著；7-9日龄时卤虫组SGR回升并接近鲢仔鱼组，可能与恢复投喂鲢仔鱼有关。
text_en: The specific growth rate (SGR) of the Artemia group was lower than that of the silver carp larval group during days 3-9, with a significant difference particularly during days 3-6; during days 7-9, the SGR of the Artemia group recovered and approached that of the silver carp larval group, possibly related to the resumption of feeding silver carp larvae.

quote:
存活率方面, 卤虫组(43%)
显著低于鲢仔鱼组(69%), 可能也与卤虫的营养供
给不足有关
[28—30]。
statement: 卤虫组鳜仔鱼的存活率(43%)显著低于鲢仔鱼组(69%)，这可能归因于卤虫营养供给不足。
text_zh: 卤虫组鳜仔鱼的存活率(43%)显著低于鲢仔鱼组(69%)，这可能归因于卤虫营养供给不足。
text_en: The survival rate of mandarin fish larvae in the Artemia group (43%) was significantly lower than that in the silver carp larvae group (69%), which may be attributed to insufficient nutritional supply from Artemia.

quote:
消化酶活性结果显示, 4 dph时, 鲢仔鱼组的胃
蛋白酶活性约为卤虫组的40倍。
statement: 在4日龄时，鲢仔鱼组鳜仔鱼的胃蛋白酶活性约为卤虫组的40倍。
text_zh: 在4日龄时，鲢仔鱼组鳜仔鱼的胃蛋白酶活性约为卤虫组的40倍。
text_en: At 4 days post-hatching, the pepsin activity of mandarin fish larvae in the silver carp larvae group was about 40 times that of the Artemia group.
intervention: Artemia vs silver carp fry as first feed
intervention_record: 卤虫与鲢仔鱼开口饵料对比

quote:
可能是因为鲢仔
鱼蛋白质含量更高(粗蛋白含量约为卤虫的2.28倍),
且氨基酸组成更契合鳜仔鱼的营养需求
[31], 能有效
刺激胃蛋白酶分泌并促进蛋白质高效利用。
statement: 鲢仔鱼更高的蛋白质含量和更契合的氨基酸组成可能有效刺激了胃蛋白酶分泌并促进了蛋白质的高效利用。
text_zh: 鲢仔鱼更高的蛋白质含量和更契合的氨基酸组成可能有效刺激了胃蛋白酶分泌并促进了蛋白质的高效利用。
text_en: The higher protein content and more suitable amino acid composition of silver carp fry may have effectively stimulated pepsin secretion and promoted efficient utilization of protein.

quote:
相比之下, 卤
虫虽含有一定的优质蛋白, 但氨基酸组成不均衡, 
且外骨骼富含几丁质, 降低了蛋白质的可
利用性
[28]。
statement: 卤虫氨基酸组成不均衡且外骨骼富含几丁质，降低了蛋白质的可利用性。
text_zh: 卤虫氨基酸组成不均衡且外骨骼富含几丁质，降低了蛋白质的可利用性。
text_en: The amino acid composition of Artemia is unbalanced and its exoskeleton is rich in chitin, which reduces protein availability.

quote:
在其他研究中也提到, 开口期鳜仔鱼对
卤虫的消化能力较弱, 影响营养的利用效率
[7, 32]。
statement: 其他研究指出，开口期鳜仔鱼对卤虫的消化能力较弱，影响了营养利用效率。
text_zh: 其他研究指出，开口期鳜仔鱼对卤虫的消化能力较弱，影响了营养利用效率。
text_en: Other studies indicate that mandarin fish larvae during the mouth-opening stage have weak digestive ability for Artemia, affecting nutrient utilization efficiency.

quote:
在这种情况下, 机体可能会通过增强胰蛋白酶和几
丁质酶分泌来弥补消化不足
[33, 34]。本研究在4和
6 dph时, 卤虫组的胰蛋白酶和几丁质酶活性均高于
鲢仔鱼组。
statement: 在4和6日龄时，卤虫组鳜仔鱼的胰蛋白酶和几丁质酶活性均高于鲢仔鱼组，这可能是机体为弥补消化不足而进行的代偿性增强。
text_zh: 在4和6日龄时，卤虫组鳜仔鱼的胰蛋白酶和几丁质酶活性均高于鲢仔鱼组，这可能是机体为弥补消化不足而进行的代偿性增强。
text_en: At 4 and 6 days post-hatching, trypsin and chitinase activities in mandarin fish larvae fed Artemia were higher than those in the group fed silver carp larvae; this may be a compensatory enhancement by the body to make up for insufficient digestion.

quote:
类似现象在其他鱼类研究中也有报道, 当
饵料营养不均衡或可消化性差时, 胰蛋白酶活性升
高, 但生长效果并不理想
[36]。
statement: 其他鱼类研究表明，当饵料营养不均衡或可消化性差时，胰蛋白酶活性升高但生长效果不理想。
text_zh: 其他鱼类研究表明，当饵料营养不均衡或可消化性差时，胰蛋白酶活性升高但生长效果不理想。
text_en: Other fish studies show that when feed nutrition is unbalanced or digestibility is poor, trypsin activity increases but growth performance is not ideal.

quote: All litters were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 and then sampled and stored at −80 °C.
statement: 所有样本均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉，随后取样并储存在−80°C。
text_zh: 所有样本均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉，随后取样并储存在−80°C。
text_en: All samples were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222, then sampled and stored at −80°C.
outcome: 采样过程中的应激控制

quote: Conversely, trypsin also influences the expression of appetite factors, and inhibition of trypsin activity similarly leads to reduced appetite, potentially involving the regulation of CCK-related pathways [ 19 ].
statement: 胰蛋白酶影响食欲因子的表达，抑制胰蛋白酶活性会导致食欲下降，这可能涉及CCK相关通路的调节。
text_zh: 胰蛋白酶影响食欲因子的表达，抑制胰蛋白酶活性会导致食欲下降，这可能涉及CCK相关通路的调节。
text_en: Trypsin affects the expression of appetite factors; inhibiting trypsin activity leads to decreased appetite, which may involve regulation of CCK-related pathways.

quote: Furthermore, the effect of trypsin on the initiation of exogenous feeding in mandarin fish larvae was explored through the use of trypsin inhibitors.
statement: 通过使用胰蛋白酶抑制剂来探索胰蛋白酶对鳜鱼幼鱼开始外源摄食的影响。
text_zh: 通过使用胰蛋白酶抑制剂来探索胰蛋白酶对鳜鱼幼鱼开始外源摄食的影响。
text_en: The effect of trypsin on the onset of exogenous feeding in juvenile mandarin fish was explored by using a trypsin inhibitor.

quote: The findings will not only deepen the theoretical understanding of evolutionary digestive physiology in fish but also provide insights into improving the initial feeding success of mandarin fish larvae by stimulating trypsin expression.
statement: 研究结果有望通过刺激胰蛋白酶表达来提高鳜鱼幼鱼的初始摄食成功率。
text_zh: 研究结果有望通过刺激胰蛋白酶表达来提高鳜鱼幼鱼的初始摄食成功率。
text_en: The research results are expected to improve the initial feeding success rate of juvenile mandarin fish by stimulating trypsin expression.

quote: During the farming process, environmental parameters were maintained as follows: dissolved oxygen in water at 7–8 mg/L, water temperature at 25.0 ± 1.0 °C, and pH between 7.8 and 8.3.
statement: 在养殖过程中，维持了特定的环境参数：水中溶解氧为7-8 mg/L，水温为25.0 ± 1.0 °C，pH值在7.8至8.3之间。
text_zh: 在养殖过程中，维持了特定的环境参数：水中溶解氧为7-8 mg/L，水温为25.0 ± 1.0 °C，pH值在7.8至8.3之间。
text_en: During the farming process, specific environmental parameters were maintained: dissolved oxygen in water was 7-8 mg/L, water temperature was 25.0 ± 1.0 °C, and pH was between 7.8 and 8.3.

quote: Prior to sampling, all embryos/larvae were deeply anesthetized using tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 100 mg/L; Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA).
statement: 在采样前，所有胚胎/幼虫均使用三卡甲磺酸（MS-222，100 mg/L）进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 在采样前，所有胚胎/幼虫均使用三卡甲磺酸（MS-222，100 mg/L）进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Before sampling, all embryos/larvae were deeply anesthetized using tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 100 mg/L).

quote: Samples were collected after deep anesthesia with MS-222 (100 mg/L). Once the individuals lost their stress responses, they were fixed in 4% PFA (for in situ hybridization) or rapidly frozen in liquid nitrogen, then stored at −80 °C for long-term preservation (for mRNA extraction).
statement: 样本在MS-222深度麻醉后采集，一旦个体失去应激反应，即被固定或快速冷冻保存。
text_zh: 样本在MS-222深度麻醉后采集，一旦个体失去应激反应，即被固定或快速冷冻保存。
text_en: Samples were collected after deep anesthesia with MS-222; once individuals lost their stress response, they were fixed or rapidly frozen for preservation.

quote: All experimental designs adhered to the principles of animal welfare, and the sampling procedures were optimized to minimize pain and distress to the experimental fish.
statement: 所有实验设计均遵循动物福利原则，且采样程序经过优化以最大限度地减少实验鱼的疼痛和痛苦。
text_zh: 所有实验设计均遵循动物福利原则，且采样程序经过优化以最大限度地减少实验鱼的疼痛和痛苦。
text_en: All experimental designs followed animal welfare principles, and sampling procedures were optimized to minimize pain and distress in the experimental fish.

quote: The results showed that, compared to untreated group, trypsin activity in the larvae was significantly reduced at 0.2, 2, and 20 mg/L TI concentrations ( Figure 5 A).
statement: 结果显示，与未处理组相比，在0.2、2和20 mg/L的TI浓度下，幼体内的胰蛋白酶活性显著降低。
text_zh: 结果显示，与未处理组相比，在0.2、2和20 mg/L的TI浓度下，幼体内的胰蛋白酶活性显著降低。
text_en: The results showed that, compared with the untreated group, trypsin activity in larvae was significantly reduced at TI concentrations of 0.2, 2 and 20 mg/L.

quote: Additionally, when observing the feeding behavior of mandarin fish larvae, we found that the feeding rate was significantly decreased at the 20 mg/L concentration of TI ( Figure 5 B).
statement: 此外，在观察鳜鱼幼虫的摄食行为时，我们发现20 mg/L浓度的胰蛋白酶抑制剂显著降低了摄食率。
text_zh: 此外，在观察鳜鱼幼虫的摄食行为时，我们发现20 mg/L浓度的胰蛋白酶抑制剂显著降低了摄食率。
text_en: In addition, when observing the feeding behavior of juvenile mandarin fish, we found that a concentration of 20 mg/L of trypsin inhibitor significantly reduced the feeding rate.

quote: Compared to untreated group, the inhibitor-treated group showed a significant increase in the expression of appetite-suppressing factors CCK and POMC.
statement: 与未处理组相比，抑制剂处理组的食欲抑制因子CCK和POMC的表达显著增加。
text_zh: 与未处理组相比，抑制剂处理组的食欲抑制因子CCK和POMC的表达显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the untreated group, the expression of appetite-suppressing factors CCK and POMC was significantly increased in the inhibitor-treated group.

quote: However, the expression of appetite-stimulating factors (NPY, and AgRP) did not exhibit significant changes.
statement: 然而，食欲刺激因子（NPY和AgRP）的表达没有表现出显著变化。
text_zh: 然而，食欲刺激因子（NPY和AgRP）的表达没有表现出显著变化。
text_en: However, the expression of appetite-stimulating factors (NPY and AgRP) did not show significant changes.

quote: These results suggest that the inhibition of trypsin activity affects the expression of CCK and POMC, thereby suppressing feeding appetite in mandarin fish larvae
statement: 这些结果表明，抑制胰蛋白酶活性会影响CCK和POMC的表达，从而抑制鳜鱼幼鱼的摄食食欲。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，抑制胰蛋白酶活性会影响CCK和POMC的表达，从而抑制鳜鱼幼鱼的摄食食欲。
text_en: These results indicate that inhibiting trypsin activity affects the expression of CCK and POMC, thereby suppressing feeding appetite in juvenile mandarin fish.

quote: Figure 6 Inhibition of 20 mg/L TI upregulates the expression of appetite-regulating factors in mandarin fish.
statement: 图6显示，20 mg/L的TI抑制上调了鳜鱼中食欲调节因子的表达。
text_zh: 图6显示，20 mg/L的TI抑制上调了鳜鱼中食欲调节因子的表达。
text_en: Figure 6 shows that 20 mg/L TI inhibition upregulated the expression of appetite-regulating factors in mandarin fish.

quote: Furthermore, inhibitor-based functional interference experiments demonstrated that trypsin regulates the mouth-opening feeding behavior of fish larvae.
statement: 此外，基于抑制剂的功能干扰实验证明，胰蛋白酶调节鱼苗开口摄食行为。
text_zh: 此外，基于抑制剂的功能干扰实验证明，胰蛋白酶调节鱼苗开口摄食行为。
text_en: In addition, functional interference experiments based on inhibitors demonstrated that trypsin regulates the first feeding behavior of fish larvae.

quote: Delayed or inadequate activation of trypsinogen could significantly impair protein digestion and thus limit larval survival during this nutritional transition.
statement: 胰蛋白酶原激活延迟或不足可能损害蛋白质消化并限制幼体存活。
text_zh: 胰蛋白酶原激活延迟或不足可能损害蛋白质消化并限制幼体存活。
text_en: Delayed or insufficient activation of trypsinogen may impair protein digestion and limit larval survival.

quote: We inhibited trypsin activity with a trypsin inhibitor, and the feeding rate of mandarin fish larvae significantly decreased, further suggesting that trypsin may somehow regulate onset of appetite.
statement: 使用胰蛋白酶抑制剂抑制胰蛋白酶活性后，鳜鱼幼鱼的摄食率显著下降。
text_zh: 使用胰蛋白酶抑制剂抑制胰蛋白酶活性后，鳜鱼幼鱼的摄食率显著下降。
text_en: After inhibiting trypsin activity with a trypsin inhibitor, the feeding rate of juvenile mandarin fish decreased significantly.

quote: These findings suggest that trypsin may exert its function by inversely regulating the expression of appetite-suppressing genes, such as CCK and POMC.
statement: 研究结果提示胰蛋白酶可能通过反向调节食欲抑制基因（如CCK和POMC）的表达来发挥作用。
text_zh: 研究结果提示胰蛋白酶可能通过反向调节食欲抑制基因（如CCK和POMC）的表达来发挥作用。
text_en: The results suggest that trypsin may act by downregulating the expression of appetite-suppressing genes (such as CCK and POMC).

quote: The larvae were fed live prey fish (zebrafish) at a ratio of 1:1.5, and their feeding proportion (the percentage of fish that were feeding in each group) was recorded over the 2 h exposure period for each group, with four repetitions.
statement: 幼鱼以1:1.5的比例投喂活饵鱼（斑马鱼），并记录各组在2小时暴露期间的摄食比例（即正在摄食的鱼的百分比），重复四次。
text_zh: 幼鱼以1:1.5的比例投喂活饵鱼（斑马鱼），并记录各组在2小时暴露期间的摄食比例（即正在摄食的鱼的百分比），重复四次。
text_en: Juvenile fish were fed live bait fish (zebrafish) at a ratio of 1:1.5, and the feeding proportion (i.e., the percentage of fish that were feeding) during a 2-hour exposure period was recorded for each group, with four repetitions.

quote: For instance, dietary supplementation of arginine could be applied to enhance trypsin activity, or leucine could be added to activate the mTOR signaling pathway and promote trypsin expression, thus stimulating feeding behavior [ 42 , 50 ].
statement: 例如，膳食补充精氨酸可用于增强胰蛋白酶活性，或添加亮氨酸以激活mTOR信号通路并促进胰蛋白酶表达，从而刺激摄食行为。
text_zh: 例如，膳食补充精氨酸可用于增强胰蛋白酶活性，或添加亮氨酸以激活mTOR信号通路并促进胰蛋白酶表达，从而刺激摄食行为。
text_en: For example, dietary arginine supplementation can be used to enhance trypsin activity, or the addition of leucine to activate the mTOR signaling pathway and promote trypsin expression, thereby stimulating feeding behavior.
intervention_record: 日粮补充精氨酸或亮氨酸

quote: trypsin modulates feeding behavior by regulating the expression of CCK and POMC.
statement: 胰蛋白酶通过调节CCK和POMC的表达来调节摄食行为。
text_zh: 胰蛋白酶通过调节CCK和POMC的表达来调节摄食行为。
text_en: Trypsin regulates feeding behavior by modulating the expression of CCK and POMC.
outcome: 摄食行为的生理调控机制

quote: Various fish species reduce or stop feeding in response to colder temperatures in the winter and start feeding again in the spring
statement: 各种鱼类在冬季低温时减少或停止摄食，并在春季恢复摄食。
text_zh: 各种鱼类在冬季低温时减少或停止摄食，并在春季恢复摄食。
text_en: Various fish species reduce or stop feeding during low winter temperatures and resume feeding in spring.

quote: The light intensity of this study was based on the experience of farmers, the surface water light intensity in the commercial fish aquaculture water was about 30 lx, and in the water of seedling domestication was about 10 lx.
statement: 本研究的设定光照强度基于养殖户的经验，商业鱼类养殖水面光照约为30勒克斯，苗种驯化水体中约为10勒克斯。
text_zh: 本研究的设定光照强度基于养殖户的经验，商业鱼类养殖水面光照约为30勒克斯，苗种驯化水体中约为10勒克斯。
text_en: The light intensity settings in this study were based on the experience of farmers; the water surface light intensity for commercial fish farming is about 30 lux, and that in larval acclimation water bodies is about 10 lux.

quote: The fish were euthanized with a high dose (500 mg/L) of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222; Sigma-Aldrich Chemie GmbH, Schnelldorf, Germany) [ 31 ] prior to dissection for the collection of gill, brain, intestine, stomach, kidney, and liver tissues in addition to plasma samples.
statement: Fish were euthanized using a high dose (500 mg/L) of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) before tissue collection.
text_en: Fish were euthanized using a high dose (500 mg/L) of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) before tissue collection.

quote: the protease and lipase activity peaked in the stomach tissues of S. chuatsi at a light intensity of 18.44 ± 3.00 lx and in intestinal tissues at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, respectively, indicating that greater light intensity increased the digestive capacity of stomach tissues, whereas lower light intensity facilitated the digestive capacity of intestinal tissues.
statement: 鳜鱼胃组织中的蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性在光照强度为18.44 ± 3.00 lx时达到峰值，而肠组织中的活性在11.15 ± 2.01 lx时达到峰值，这表明较高的光照强度增加了胃组织的消化能力，而较低的光照强度促进了肠组织的消化能力。
text_zh: 鳜鱼胃组织中的蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性在光照强度为18.44 ± 3.00 lx时达到峰值，而肠组织中的活性在11.15 ± 2.01 lx时达到峰值，这表明较高的光照强度增加了胃组织的消化能力，而较低的光照强度促进了肠组织的消化能力。
text_en: The protease and lipase activities in the gastric tissue of mandarin fish peaked at a light intensity of 18.44 ± 3.00 lx, while the activities in the intestinal tissue peaked at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, indicating that higher light intensity increased the digestive capacity of the gastric tissue, whereas lower light intensity promoted the digestive capacity of the intestinal tissue.

quote: The tissues of the gill, stomach, and intestine had relatively high activity of stress-related enzymes, whereas the tissues of the brain, kidney, liver, and plasma samples had relatively low activity of enzymes.
statement: 鳃、胃和肠组织中与应激相关的酶活性相对较高，而脑、肾、肝和血浆样本中的酶活性相对较低。
text_zh: 鳃、胃和肠组织中与应激相关的酶活性相对较高，而脑、肾、肝和血浆样本中的酶活性相对较低。
text_en: Enzyme activities related to stress were relatively high in gill, stomach, and intestinal tissues, while they were relatively low in brain, kidney, liver, and plasma samples.

quote: Collectively, the results show that light intensity at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx promoted digestive capacity in the intestine and enhanced the anti-stress ability of S. chuatsi in response to stress induced by re-feeding after starvation.
statement: 结果表明，11.15 ± 2.01 lx的光照强度促进了肠道消化能力，并增强了鳜鱼对禁食后复喂引起的应激的抗应激能力。
text_zh: 结果表明，11.15 ± 2.01 lx的光照强度促进了肠道消化能力，并增强了鳜鱼对禁食后复喂引起的应激的抗应激能力。
text_en: The results showed that a light intensity of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx promoted intestinal digestive capacity and enhanced the stress resistance of Chinese perch to stress induced by refeeding after fasting.
outcome: 消化能力与抗应激能力

quote: enhancing trypsin activity may suppress the expression of appetite-suppressing factors, thereby improving the first feeding rate in mandarin fish.
statement: 增强胰蛋白酶活性可能会抑制食欲抑制因子的表达，从而提高鳜鱼的首次摄食率。
text_zh: 增强胰蛋白酶活性可能会抑制食欲抑制因子的表达，从而提高鳜鱼的首次摄食率。
text_en: Enhancing trypsin activity may inhibit the expression of appetite-suppressing factors, thereby improving the first feeding rate of mandarin fish.

quote: The studies mentioned above confirmed that light with satisfactory intensity and color promotes the growth and survival of fish and that too much light can be hazardous via disruption of circadian rhythm.
statement: 先前研究证实，具有令人满意的强度和颜色的光能促进鱼类的生长和存活，而过多的光会通过破坏昼夜节律造成危害。
text_zh: 先前研究证实，具有令人满意的强度和颜色的光能促进鱼类的生长和存活，而过多的光会通过破坏昼夜节律造成危害。
text_en: Previous studies have confirmed that light with satisfactory intensity and color can promote the growth and survival of fish, while excessive light causes harm by disrupting circadian rhythms.
outcome: 生长、存活及昼夜节律稳定性
counterevidence: 过多的光可能通过破坏昼夜节律对鱼类有害

quote: The activity of digestive enzymes (protease, lipase, amylase) can reflect the digestive ability of fish to food [ 26 ].
statement: 消化酶（蛋白酶、脂肪酶、淀粉酶）的活性可以反映鱼类对食物的消化能力。
text_zh: 消化酶（蛋白酶、脂肪酶、淀粉酶）的活性可以反映鱼类对食物的消化能力。
text_en: The activity of digestive enzymes (protease, lipase, amylase) can reflect the fish's ability to digest food.

quote: Whether the fish is under hunger stress or fed with different feeds, the activity of digestive enzymes can reflect the adaptability of the fish to the environment and the health status of the fish to a certain extent [ 27 ].
statement: 无论鱼类处于饥饿应激状态还是喂食不同饲料，消化酶的活性在一定程度上都能反映鱼类对环境的适应能力和健康状况。
text_zh: 无论鱼类处于饥饿应激状态还是喂食不同饲料，消化酶的活性在一定程度上都能反映鱼类对环境的适应能力和健康状况。
text_en: Whether fish are in a state of starvation stress or fed different diets, the activity of digestive enzymes can reflect, to some extent, the fish's ability to adapt to the environment and their health status.
outcome: 环境适应能力与健康状况

quote: The activity of stress-related enzymes in the fish can directly reflect whether the fish is in a state of stress.
statement: 鱼类中应激相关酶的活性可以直接反映鱼类是否处于应激状态。
text_zh: 鱼类中应激相关酶的活性可以直接反映鱼类是否处于应激状态。
text_en: The activity of stress-related enzymes in fish can directly reflect whether the fish is in a state of stress.

quote: In the present study, at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, S. chuatsi sustained relatively lower stress in response to re-feeding after starvation and digestive enzyme activities in the intestine were the highest, indicating that the light intensity was most suitable for re-feeding of S. chuatsi after starvation.
statement: 在11.15 ± 2.01 lx的光照强度下，鳜鱼在饥饿后重新摄食时承受的压力相对较低，且肠道消化酶活性最高。
text_zh: 在11.15 ± 2.01 lx的光照强度下，鳜鱼在饥饿后重新摄食时承受的压力相对较低，且肠道消化酶活性最高。
text_en: At a light intensity of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, mandarin fish experienced relatively low stress when resuming feeding after starvation, and intestinal digestive enzyme activity was highest.

quote: Thus, under weak light, S. chuatsi is most likely to consume compound feed.
statement: 因此，在弱光条件下，鳜鱼最有可能食用配合饲料。
text_zh: 因此，在弱光条件下，鳜鱼最有可能食用配合饲料。
text_en: Therefore, under low light conditions, mandarin fish are most likely to eat formulated feed.

quote: Moreover, reducing the light intensity can increase the activity of digestive enzymes in the intestine while alleviating the stress response and facilitate successful domestication of S. chuatsi .
statement: 此外，降低光照强度可以增加肠道消化酶的活性，同时缓解应激反应，并促进鳜鱼的成功驯化。
text_zh: 此外，降低光照强度可以增加肠道消化酶的活性，同时缓解应激反应，并促进鳜鱼的成功驯化。
text_en: In addition, reducing light intensity can increase the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes, alleviate stress responses, and promote the successful acclimation of mandarin fish.
outcome: 消化功能、应激反应与驯化

quote: Acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), alanine aminotransferase (GPT), aspartate aminotransferase (GOT), and other stress-related enzymes are often used to measure the stress response and adaptability of fish to stress after being stimulated
statement: 酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶、乳酸脱氢酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、谷丙转氨酶、谷草转氨酶等应激相关酶常用于测定鱼类受刺激后的应激反应和适应性。
text_zh: 酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶、乳酸脱氢酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、谷丙转氨酶、谷草转氨酶等应激相关酶常用于测定鱼类受刺激后的应激反应和适应性。
text_en: Stress-related enzymes such as acid phosphatase, alkaline phosphatase, lactate dehydrogenase, superoxide dismutase, catalase, alanine aminotransferase, and aspartate aminotransferase are commonly used to measure the stress response and adaptability of fish after stimulation.

quote: An appropriate amount of light can alleviate stress on the fish.
statement: 适量的光照可以缓解鱼类的应激。
text_zh: 适量的光照可以缓解鱼类的应激。
text_en: Moderate light intensity can alleviate stress in fish.

quote: Re-feeding after starvation can cause a stress response in S . chuatsi .
statement: 禁食后重新投喂会引起翘嘴鲌的应激反应。
text_zh: 禁食后重新投喂会引起翘嘴鲌的应激反应。
text_en: Refedding after fasting causes a stress response in Culter alburnus.

quote: In the present study, different light intensities were applied to mimic natural periodic light–dark cycles on S. chuatsi to assess changes to the activity of enzymes involved in digestion and stress and to determine whether the satisfactory intensity of light can alleviate stress induced by re-feeding after starvation, as well as to clarify the underlying mechanisms.
statement: 本研究对翘嘴鲌施加不同光照强度以模拟自然周期性明暗循环，旨在评估消化和应激相关酶活性的变化，并确定满意的光照强度是否能缓解禁食后重新投喂引起的应激。
text_zh: 本研究对翘嘴鲌施加不同光照强度以模拟自然周期性明暗循环，旨在评估消化和应激相关酶活性的变化，并确定满意的光照强度是否能缓解禁食后重新投喂引起的应激。
text_en: This study applied different light intensities to Culter alburnus to simulate natural periodic light-dark cycles, aiming to evaluate changes in the activities of digestive and stress-related enzymes, and to determine whether satisfactory light intensity can alleviate stress caused by re-feeding after fasting.

quote: The light intensity was measured at the center of the bottom of the aquarium with a ZDS-10W underwater illuminometer (TIANWEI, China).
statement: 使用ZDS-10W水下照度计在水族箱底部中心测量光照强度。
text_zh: 使用ZDS-10W水下照度计在水族箱底部中心测量光照强度。
text_en: Light intensity was measured at the center of the bottom of the aquarium using a ZDS-10W underwater illuminance meter.

quote: Feed was withheld for 7 days prior to re-feeding, and feeding with satiety (3% of body weight) at 8: 00 a.m. was carried out on the 8th day.
statement: 在重新喂食前禁食7天，并在第8天上午8点以饱食状态（体重的3%）进行投喂。
text_zh: 在重新喂食前禁食7天，并在第8天上午8点以饱食状态（体重的3%）进行投喂。
text_en: Fasting for 7 days before refeeding, and feeding to satiation (3% of body weight) at 8:00 AM on the 8th day.

quote: No fish died during the experimental period.
statement: 实验期间没有鱼死亡。
text_zh: 实验期间没有鱼死亡。
text_en: No fish died during the experimental period.

quote: The maximum protein content was observed in most samples at a lower light intensity of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, except for the brain and liver, for which the total protein content was significantly higher than that under one or more other light intensities.
statement: 在大多数样本中，最低光照强度（11.15 ± 2.01 lx）下观察到最大蛋白质含量，但脑和肝脏除外，其总蛋白含量显著高于其他一种或多种光照强度下的水平。
text_zh: 在大多数样本中，最低光照强度（11.15 ± 2.01 lx）下观察到最大蛋白质含量，但脑和肝脏除外，其总蛋白含量显著高于其他一种或多种光照强度下的水平。
text_en: In most samples, the maximum protein content was observed at the lowest light intensity (11.15 ± 2.01 lx), except for the brain and liver, where total protein content was significantly higher than under one or more other light intensities.
counterevidence: 脑和肝脏的总蛋白含量在低光照下并非最高，而是显著高于其他光照条件。

quote: At a light intensity greater than 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, ACP activity was more likely to be lower in all samples.
statement: 当光照强度大于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，所有样本中的酸性磷酸酶（ACP）活性更可能较低。
text_zh: 当光照强度大于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，所有样本中的酸性磷酸酶（ACP）活性更可能较低。
text_en: When light intensity is greater than 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, acid phosphatase (ACP) activity in all samples is more likely to be lower.

quote: The trend of changes in GOT activity in all tissues reached significant levels ( p 0.01 or p 0.05).
statement: 所有组织中GOT活性的变化趋势均达到显著水平。
text_zh: 所有组织中GOT活性的变化趋势均达到显著水平。
text_en: The trend of changes in GOT activity in all tissues reached a significant level.

quote: Satisfactory light affects the growth and reproduction of aquatic species, including S. chuatsi , by promoting feeding and the ability to identify potential food sources, especially in the juvenile stage
statement: 适宜的光照通过促进摄食和识别潜在食物来源的能力，影响包括鳜鱼在内的水生物种的生长和繁殖，尤其是在幼鱼阶段。
text_zh: 适宜的光照通过促进摄食和识别潜在食物来源的能力，影响包括鳜鱼在内的水生物种的生长和繁殖，尤其是在幼鱼阶段。
text_en: Appropriate light affects the growth and reproduction of aquatic species, including mandarin fish, by promoting feeding and the ability to identify potential food sources, especially during the juvenile stage.

quote: As shown in Figure 4 , the changes in gill, brain, and stomach tissues were basically consistent, showing a trend of first increasing, then decreasing, and finally increasing.
statement: 如图4所示，鳃、脑和胃组织的变化基本一致，呈现先升高、后降低、最后升高的趋势。
text_zh: 如图4所示，鳃、脑和胃组织的变化基本一致，呈现先升高、后降低、最后升高的趋势。
text_en: As shown in Figure 4, the changes in gill, brain, and stomach tissues were basically consistent, presenting a trend of first increasing, then decreasing, and finally increasing.
outcome: 应激相关酶活性变化趋势

quote: The activity of α -amylase in the intestinal and stomach tissues, except at 21.04 ± 2.72 lx, showed basically the same rate of change and peaked at 13.43 ± 2.35 lx prior to decreasing again.
statement: 除21.04 ± 2.72 lx外，肠道和胃组织中α-淀粉酶活性的变化率基本相同，并在13.43 ± 2.35 lx处达到峰值后再次下降。
text_zh: 除21.04 ± 2.72 lx外，肠道和胃组织中α-淀粉酶活性的变化率基本相同，并在13.43 ± 2.35 lx处达到峰值后再次下降。
text_en: Except for 21.04 ± 2.72 lx, the rate of change in α-amylase activity in intestinal and gastric tissues was basically the same, reaching a peak at 13.43 ± 2.35 lx before declining again.

quote: As shown in Figure 8 , the changes in the gill, brain, and kidney tissues were basically consistent, showing a trend of first decreasing, then increasing, and finally decreasing.
statement: Figure 8显示，鳃、脑和肾脏组织中过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先下降、后上升、再下降。
text_zh: Figure 8显示，鳃、脑和肾脏组织中过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先下降、后上升、再下降。
text_en: Figure 8 shows that the trends in catalase (CAT) activity in gill, brain, and kidney tissues were basically consistent, exhibiting a pattern of first decreasing, then increasing, and then decreasing again.

quote: The changes in the stomach and liver tissues were basically consistent, showing a trend of first decreasing, then increasing, then decreasing, and finally increasing, and the trend of changes in the intestine was exactly the opposite.
statement: 胃和肝脏组织中CAT活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先降、后升、再降、最后升；而肠道组织的变化趋势则完全相反。
text_zh: 胃和肝脏组织中CAT活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先降、后升、再降、最后升；而肠道组织的变化趋势则完全相反。
text_en: The trend of changes in CAT activity in the stomach and liver tissues was basically consistent, showing a decrease first, then an increase, followed by another decrease, and finally an increase; whereas the trend in intestinal tissue was completely opposite.

quote: The plasma samples showed a trend of first decreasing and then increasing.
statement: 血浆样本中CAT活性呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_zh: 血浆样本中CAT活性呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_en: CAT activity in plasma samples showed a trend of decreasing first and then increasing.

quote: At a light intensity greater than 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, CAT activity was more likely to peak in most tissues.
statement: 当光照强度大于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，大多数组织中的CAT活性更有可能达到峰值。
text_zh: 当光照强度大于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，大多数组织中的CAT活性更有可能达到峰值。
text_en: When light intensity is greater than 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, CAT activity in most tissues is more likely to reach its peak.

quote: At a light intensity lower than 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, CAT activity was more likely to be minimal in most tissues.
statement: 当光照强度低于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，大多数组织中的CAT活性更有可能处于最低值。
text_zh: 当光照强度低于15.75 ± 2.88 lx时，大多数组织中的CAT活性更有可能处于最低值。
text_en: When light intensity is below 15.75 ± 2.88 lx, CAT activity in most tissues is more likely to be at its lowest value.

quote: As shown in Figure 7 , the changes in the brain, intestine, kidney, and plasma samples were basically consistent, showing a trend of first decreasing, then increasing, and finally decreasing.
statement: 在图7中，脑、肠、肾和血浆样本中的SOD活性变化基本一致，呈现先下降、后上升、最后下降的趋势。
text_zh: 在图7中，脑、肠、肾和血浆样本中的SOD活性变化基本一致，呈现先下降、后上升、最后下降的趋势。
text_en: In Figure 7, the changes in SOD activity in brain, intestine, kidney, and plasma samples were basically consistent, showing a trend of first decreasing, then increasing, and finally decreasing.

quote: The change in the liver tissues was basically consistent, showing a trend of first increasing, then decreasing, and finally increasing.
statement: 肝脏组织中的SOD活性变化基本一致，呈现先上升、后下降、最后上升的趋势。
text_zh: 肝脏组织中的SOD活性变化基本一致，呈现先上升、后下降、最后上升的趋势。
text_en: The changes in SOD activity in liver tissue were basically consistent, showing a trend of first rising, then falling, and finally rising.

quote: The gill and stomach tissues showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing.
statement: 鳃和胃组织的SOD活性呈现先上升后下降的趋势。
text_zh: 鳃和胃组织的SOD活性呈现先上升后下降的趋势。
text_en: SOD activity in gill and stomach tissues showed a trend of increasing first and then decreasing.

quote: Except for brain and stomach tissues, the trend of changes in SOD activity in other tissues reached significant levels ( p 0.01 or p 0.05).
statement: 除脑和胃组织外，其他组织中SOD活性的变化趋势达到了显著水平（p < 0.01 或 p < 0.05）。
text_zh: 除脑和胃组织外，其他组织中SOD活性的变化趋势达到了显著水平（p < 0.01 或 p < 0.05）。
text_en: Except for brain and stomach tissues, the changes in SOD activity in other tissues reached a significant level (p < 0.01 or p < 0.05).

quote: At light intensity greater than 13.43 ± 2.35 lx, SOD activities were more likely to peak in all tissues.
statement: 当光照强度大于13.43 ± 2.35 lx时，所有组织中的SOD活性更有可能达到峰值。
text_zh: 当光照强度大于13.43 ± 2.35 lx时，所有组织中的SOD活性更有可能达到峰值。
text_en: When light intensity is greater than 13.43 ± 2.35 lx, SOD activity in all tissues is more likely to reach a peak.

quote: When the light intensity was 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, SOD activities were more likely to be minimal in most tissues.
statement: 当光照强度为11.15 ± 2.01 lx时，大多数组织中的SOD活性更有可能处于最低值。
text_zh: 当光照强度为11.15 ± 2.01 lx时，大多数组织中的SOD活性更有可能处于最低值。
text_en: When the light intensity was 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, SOD activity in most tissues was more likely to be at its lowest value.

quote: adjusting the intensity of environmental lighting is more economical and relatively simple
statement: 调整环境光照强度比改善饲料的形状、颜色、风味和口感更经济且相对简单。
text_zh: 调整环境光照强度比改善饲料的形状、颜色、风味和口感更经济且相对简单。
text_en: Adjusting environmental light intensity is more economical and relatively simpler than improving the shape, color, flavor, and texture of feed.
outcome: 养殖管理成本与操作简便性

quote: In this study, light intensity altered digestive enzyme activity, demonstrating that appropriate light intensity can increase the activity of digestive enzymes, thereby promoting the digestion ability of food.
statement: 本研究表明，光照强度改变了消化酶活性，证明适当的光照强度可以增加消化酶的活性，从而促进食物的消化能力。
text_zh: 本研究表明，光照强度改变了消化酶活性，证明适当的光照强度可以增加消化酶的活性，从而促进食物的消化能力。
text_en: This study shows that light intensity changed digestive enzyme activity, demonstrating that appropriate light intensity can increase the activity of digestive enzymes, thereby promoting food digestion capacity.
outcome: 消化酶活性与消化能力

quote: The maximum protease and lipase activity was higher at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx than at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, suggesting that gastric tissues may play a greater role in food digestion of S. chuatsi and that digestion was strongest at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx
statement: 在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时的最大蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性高于11.15 ± 2.01 lx时，表明胃组织可能在鳜鱼的食物消化中发挥更大作用，且在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时光照下的消化最强。
text_zh: 在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时的最大蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性高于11.15 ± 2.01 lx时，表明胃组织可能在鳜鱼的食物消化中发挥更大作用，且在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时光照下的消化最强。
text_en: The maximum protease and lipase activities at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx were higher than those at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, indicating that the gastric tissue may play a greater role in food digestion in mandarin fish, and digestion was strongest under illumination at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx.

quote: Light colors are also more comforting to some fish [ 39 ] and promote feeding but not necessarily growth [ 15 ].
statement: 光色对某些鱼类更具安抚作用并促进摄食，但不一定促进生长。
text_zh: 光色对某些鱼类更具安抚作用并促进摄食，但不一定促进生长。
text_en: Light color has a more calming effect on certain fish species and promotes feeding, but does not necessarily promote growth.

quote: At a light intensity of 100 – 1600 lx, SOD activity in the liver of Wuchang bream ( Megalobrama amblycephala ) increased, whereas CAT activity first decreased and then increased with increasing light intensity [ 49 ]
statement: 在100–1600 lx的光照强度下，鳊鱼肝脏中的SOD活性增加，而CAT活性随光照强度增加先降低后升高。
text_zh: 在100–1600 lx的光照强度下，鳊鱼肝脏中的SOD活性增加，而CAT活性随光照强度增加先降低后升高。
text_en: Under light intensities of 100–1600 lx, SOD activity in the liver of bream increased, while CAT activity first decreased and then increased with increasing light intensity.

quote: Phototaxis combined with a preference for light colors guide fish to avoid areas that can have negative impacts and prevent gathering in high numbers [ 10 , 11 , 50 ].
statement: 趋光性结合对光色的偏好引导鱼类避开可能产生负面影响的区域，并防止大量聚集。
text_zh: 趋光性结合对光色的偏好引导鱼类避开可能产生负面影响的区域，并防止大量聚集。
text_en: Phototaxis combined with preference for light color guides fish to avoid areas that may have negative effects and prevents mass aggregation.

quote: Tian et al. [ 49 ] found that light intensity at 400 lx was most suitable for the growth of juvenile M. amblycephala
statement: Tian等人发现400 lx的光照强度最适合鳊鱼幼鱼的生长。
text_zh: Tian等人发现400 lx的光照强度最适合鳊鱼幼鱼的生长。
text_en: Tian et al. found that a light intensity of 400 lx was most suitable for the growth of juvenile bream.

quote: Han et al. [ 51 ] found that the intensity of light did not affect the survival rate of Leiocassis longirostris , but it significantly affected its growth rate and also affected its body color.
statement: Han等人发现光照强度不影响长吻鮠的存活率，但显著影响其生长速率和体色。
text_zh: Han等人发现光照强度不影响长吻鮠的存活率，但显著影响其生长速率和体色。
text_en: Han et al. found that light intensity did not affect the survival rate of Leiocassis longirostris, but significantly affected its growth rate and body color.
outcome: 存活率、生长速率及体色

quote: It is worth noting that the activity of the digestive enzymes was greater at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx than 11.15 ± 2.01 lx.
statement: 值得注意的是，在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时的消化酶活性高于11.15 ± 2.01 lx时。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在18.44 ± 3.00 lx时的消化酶活性高于11.15 ± 2.01 lx时。
text_en: It is worth noting that digestive enzyme activity at 18.44 ± 3.00 lx was higher than at 11.15 ± 2.01 lx.

quote: Use of artificial light to control swimming depth and fish density of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) in production cages.
statement: 人工光照可用于控制养殖网箱中大西洋鲑的游泳深度和鱼群密度。
text_zh: 人工光照可用于控制养殖网箱中大西洋鲑的游泳深度和鱼群密度。
text_en: Artificial light can be used to control the swimming depth and school density of Atlantic salmon in farming cages.

quote: Submerged light increases swimming depth and reduces fish density of Atlantic salmon Salmo salar L. in production cages.
statement: 水下光照增加了养殖网箱中大西洋鲑的游泳深度并降低了鱼群密度。
text_zh: 水下光照增加了养殖网箱中大西洋鲑的游泳深度并降低了鱼群密度。
text_en: Underwater light increased the swimming depth of Atlantic salmon in farming cages and reduced school density.

quote: Spotlight on fish: Light pollution affects circadian rhythms of European perch but does not cause stress.
statement: 光污染影响欧洲鲈鱼的昼夜节律，但不会引起应激反应。
text_zh: 光污染影响欧洲鲈鱼的昼夜节律，但不会引起应激反应。
text_en: Light pollution affects the circadian rhythm of European sea bass, but does not cause a stress response.

quote: From the relevant indicator data of this study, it was found that at a light of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, the stress response of S . chuatsi to re-feeding after starvation was relatively low.
statement: 根据本研究的相关指标数据发现，在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 的光照下，鳜鱼对禁食后复食的应激反应相对较低。
text_zh: 根据本研究的相关指标数据发现，在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 的光照下，鳜鱼对禁食后复食的应激反应相对较低。
text_en: According to the relevant indicator data of this study, under illumination of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, the stress response of mandarin fish to refeeding after fasting was relatively low.

quote: Hence, cultivation of S . chuatsi under the conditions of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx can facilitate nutrient absorption.
statement: 因此，在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 的条件下养殖鳜鱼可以促进营养吸收。
text_zh: 因此，在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 的条件下养殖鳜鱼可以促进营养吸收。
text_en: Therefore, farming mandarin fish under conditions of 11.15 ± 2.01 lx can promote nutrient absorption.

quote: At 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, S. chuatsi sustained relatively lower stress in response to re-feeding after starvation and digestive enzyme activity in the intestine was the highest, indicating that this light intensity is most suitable for re-feeding of S. chuatsi after starvation to promote growth and development.
statement: 在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 时，鳜鱼对禁食后复食的应激反应较低且肠道消化酶活性最高，表明该光照强度最适合鳜鱼禁食后的复食以促进生长发育。
text_zh: 在 11.15 ± 2.01 lx 时，鳜鱼对禁食后复食的应激反应较低且肠道消化酶活性最高，表明该光照强度最适合鳜鱼禁食后的复食以促进生长发育。
text_en: At 11.15 ± 2.01 lx, the stress response of mandarin fish to refeeding after fasting was low and intestinal digestive enzyme activity was highest, indicating that this light intensity is most suitable for refeeding mandarin fish after fasting to promote growth and development.

quote: Under light conditions, S. chuatsi only preys on fish but will also consume shrimp under dark conditions, and weak light can reduce the accuracy of predation.
statement: 在有光条件下，鳜鱼仅捕食鱼类；而在黑暗条件下也会摄食虾类，弱光会降低其捕食的准确性。
text_zh: 在有光条件下，鳜鱼仅捕食鱼类；而在黑暗条件下也会摄食虾类，弱光会降低其捕食的准确性。
text_en: Under light conditions, mandarin fish prey only on fish; under dark conditions they also consume shrimp, and weak light reduces their predation accuracy.

quote: Moreover, reducing the light intensity increases the activities of digestive enzymes in intestine while alleviating the stress response and will facilitate successful domestication of S. chuatsi .
statement: 此外，降低光照强度会增加肠道消化酶的活性，同时缓解应激反应，这将有助于鳜鱼的成功驯化。
text_zh: 此外，降低光照强度会增加肠道消化酶的活性，同时缓解应激反应，这将有助于鳜鱼的成功驯化。
text_en: In addition, reducing light intensity increases the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes and alleviates stress responses, which will help in the successful domestication of mandarin fish.
outcome: 消化酶活性、应激反应及驯化成功率

quote: Collectively, the results of the present study suggest that a suitable light intensity can accelerate the adaptation of S. chuatsi to stress caused by re-feeding and regulate the inclination of S. chuatsi to consume compound feed.
statement: 总之，本研究结果表明，适宜的光照强度可以加速鳜鱼对重新摄食引起的应激的适应，并调节其摄食配合饲料的倾向。
text_zh: 总之，本研究结果表明，适宜的光照强度可以加速鳜鱼对重新摄食引起的应激的适应，并调节其摄食配合饲料的倾向。
text_en: In summary, the results of this study indicate that appropriate light intensity can accelerate the adaptation of mandarin fish to stress caused by refeeding and regulate their tendency to consume formulated feed.

quote: The photoperiod group of 12L: 12D and the water temperature group of 18 °C presented a higher abundance of Malondialdehyde (MDA) and lower abundances of Superoxide dismutase (SOD), Glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), and Catalase (CAT) than other groups ( p 0.05).
statement: 在12L:12D光周期和18°C水温条件下，斑点鳜鱼幼鱼的丙二醛（MDA）含量较高，而超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性较低。
text_zh: 在12L:12D光周期和18°C水温条件下，斑点鳜鱼幼鱼的丙二醛（MDA）含量较高，而超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性较低。
text_en: Under a 12L:12D photoperiod and water temperature of 18°C, the malondialdehyde (MDA) content in juvenile spotted mandarin fish was higher, while the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), and catalase (CAT) were lower.

quote: No significant difference in intestinal microbial diversity was found among different groups ( p 0.05), except that the ACE index showed significant differences among different temperature gro
statement: 不同处理组之间肠道微生物多样性无显著差异，但不同温度组的ACE指数存在显著差异。
text_zh: 不同处理组之间肠道微生物多样性无显著差异，但不同温度组的ACE指数存在显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in intestinal microbial diversity between different treatment groups, but there was a significant difference in the ACE index between different temperature groups.

quote: Modifying the duration of light exposure could effectively mitigate oxidative reactions and optimal high temperatures could suppress oxidation in juvenile S. scherzeri .
statement: 改变光照持续时间可以有效减轻氧化反应，而最佳高温可以抑制幼鱼S. scherzeri的氧化。
text_zh: 改变光照持续时间可以有效减轻氧化反应，而最佳高温可以抑制幼鱼S. scherzeri的氧化。
text_en: Changing the light duration can effectively reduce oxidative stress, while optimal high temperature can inhibit oxidation in juvenile S. scherzeri.

quote: However, these conditions also influenced the feeding behavior of juvenile S. scherzeri and the composition of intestinal microbiota and promoted the proliferation of opportunistic bacteria.
statement: 然而，这些条件也影响了幼鱼S. scherzeri的摄食行为和肠道微生物群落的组成，并促进了机会致病菌的增殖。
text_zh: 然而，这些条件也影响了幼鱼S. scherzeri的摄食行为和肠道微生物群落的组成，并促进了机会致病菌的增殖。
text_en: However, these conditions also affected the feeding behavior and gut microbiota composition of juvenile S. scherzeri, and promoted the proliferation of opportunistic pathogens.

quote: When water temperature is within the appropriate range for aquaculture, the food intake, metabolism rate, and growth rate of fish increase [ 4 ].
statement: 当水温处于水产养殖的适宜范围内时，鱼的摄食量、代谢率和生长率会增加。
text_zh: 当水温处于水产养殖的适宜范围内时，鱼的摄食量、代谢率和生长率会增加。
text_en: When the water temperature is within the suitable range for aquaculture, fish feed intake, metabolic rate, and growth rate increase.

quote: Once water temperature is beyond this range, the food intake, metabolism rate, and growth rate of fish decrease, and fish may even die [ 5 , 6 ].
statement: 一旦水温超出此范围，鱼的摄食量、代谢率和生长率就会下降，鱼甚至可能死亡。
text_zh: 一旦水温超出此范围，鱼的摄食量、代谢率和生长率就会下降，鱼甚至可能死亡。
text_en: Once the water temperature exceeds this range, fish feed intake, metabolic rate and growth rate will decrease, and fish may even die.

quote: 12L: 12D photoperiod, suggesting that extended light exposure increased antioxidant enzyme activity [ 17 ].
statement: 12L:12D光周期表明延长光照暴露增加了抗氧化酶活性。
text_zh: 12L:12D光周期表明延长光照暴露增加了抗氧化酶活性。
text_en: The 12L:12D photoperiod indicated that extended light exposure increased antioxidant enzyme activity.
outcome: 氧化应激/抗氧化酶活性

quote: However, against the backdrop of the gradual popularization of intensive aquaculture practices, health issues in fish caused by improper regulation of environmental factors have become increasingly prominent.
statement: 在集约化养殖实践逐渐普及的背景下，由环境因素调节不当引起的鱼类健康问题日益突出。
text_zh: 在集约化养殖实践逐渐普及的背景下，由环境因素调节不当引起的鱼类健康问题日益突出。
text_en: Against the backdrop of the gradual adoption of intensive farming practices, fish health problems caused by improper regulation of environmental factors have become increasingly prominent.

quote: Among the numerous environmental factors, light and temperature are fundamental and highly variable physical parameters that persist throughout the entire aquaculture cycle, profoundly influencing the physiological rhythms, metabolic rates, and stress responses of fish [ 23 , 24 ].
statement: 在众多环境因素中，光和温度是贯穿整个养殖周期的基本且高度可变的物理参数，深刻影响鱼类的生理节律、代谢率和应激反应。
text_zh: 在众多环境因素中，光和温度是贯穿整个养殖周期的基本且高度可变的物理参数，深刻影响鱼类的生理节律、代谢率和应激反应。
text_en: Among many environmental factors, light and temperature are basic and highly variable physical parameters throughout the entire farming cycle, profoundly affecting fish physiological rhythms, metabolic rates, and stress responses.
outcome: 生理节律、代谢率、应激反应

quote: In the breeding process, an accurate range of suitable water temperature is required for fish to accelerate growth, shorten the breeding period, save costs, and improve survival rate and yield at various stages
statement: 在养殖过程中，准确的适宜水温范围对于鱼类加速生长、缩短养殖周期、节约成本以及提高各阶段的存活率和产量是必需的。
text_zh: 在养殖过程中，准确的适宜水温范围对于鱼类加速生长、缩短养殖周期、节约成本以及提高各阶段的存活率和产量是必需的。
text_en: In the aquaculture process, an accurate optimal water temperature range is essential for accelerating fish growth, shortening the culture cycle, saving costs, and improving survival rates and yield at each stage.

quote: the increase in water temperature causes the concentration of dissolved oxygen in water to decrease and changes the structure and number of phytoplankton and animals and the habitat of fish
statement: 水温升高会导致水中溶解氧浓度降低，并改变浮游植物和动物的结构与数量以及鱼类的栖息地。
text_zh: 水温升高会导致水中溶解氧浓度降低，并改变浮游植物和动物的结构与数量以及鱼类的栖息地。
text_en: Rising water temperature leads to a decrease in dissolved oxygen concentration in the water, and changes the structure and abundance of phytoplankton and zooplankton as well as fish habitats.

quote: Similarity to water temperature, photoperiod also affects the growth, feeding, development, and spawning of fish
statement: 与水温类似，光周期也影响鱼类的生长、摄食、发育和产卵。
text_zh: 与水温类似，光周期也影响鱼类的生长、摄食、发育和产卵。
text_en: Similar to water temperature, photoperiod also affects the growth, feeding, development and spawning of fish.

quote: The optimization of an artificial light regime can accelerate fish growth
statement: 优化人工光照制度可以加速鱼类生长。
text_zh: 优化人工光照制度可以加速鱼类生长。
text_en: Optimizing the artificial lighting regime can accelerate fish growth.

quote: It was reported that light had significant influences on physiological stress in fish cultures, such as faster growth induced by an increased light duration, the enhanced immune system of fish by specific wavelengths of light, and reduced stress levels
statement: 据报道，光照对鱼类养殖中的生理应激有显著影响，例如增加光照时长诱导的快速生长、特定波长光线增强的鱼类免疫系统以及降低的应激水平。
text_zh: 据报道，光照对鱼类养殖中的生理应激有显著影响，例如增加光照时长诱导的快速生长、特定波长光线增强的鱼类免疫系统以及降低的应激水平。
text_en: It is reported that light has a significant effect on physiological stress in fish farming, for example, rapid growth induced by increased light duration, enhanced fish immune systems with specific wavelengths of light, and reduced stress levels.

quote: An inappropriate photoperiod may lead to the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) at varying levels, thereby inducing oxidative stress
statement: 不适当的光周期可能导致活性氧（ROS）在不同水平上产生，从而诱导氧化应激。
text_zh: 不适当的光周期可能导致活性氧（ROS）在不同水平上产生，从而诱导氧化应激。
text_en: Inappropriate photoperiods may lead to the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) at different levels, thereby inducing oxidative stress.

quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate the relationship between the stress response and light in S. chuatsi .
statement: 据作者所知，这是第一项研究鳜鱼（S. chuatsi）应激反应与光照之间关系的研究。
text_zh: 据作者所知，这是第一项研究鳜鱼（S. chuatsi）应激反应与光照之间关系的研究。
text_en: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first study on the relationship between stress response and light in mandarin fish (S. chuatsi).

quote: Although limited, previous studies of light-related stress have mainly focused on cortisol, blood glucose, and other indicators [ 39 , 40 ].
statement: 尽管有限，但以往关于光相关应激的研究主要集中在皮质醇、血糖和其他指标上。
text_zh: 尽管有限，但以往关于光相关应激的研究主要集中在皮质醇、血糖和其他指标上。
text_en: Although limited, previous research on light-related stress has mainly focused on cortisol, blood glucose, and other indicators.

quote: The gills can be directly exposed to various environmental stimuli, such as hypoxia [ 43 ] and nitrite toxicity [ 44 ]; thus, the stress response may be stronger than that of other tissues.
statement: 鳃可以直接暴露于各种环境刺激，如缺氧和亚硝酸盐毒性；因此，其应激反应可能比其他组织更强。
text_zh: 鳃可以直接暴露于各种环境刺激，如缺氧和亚硝酸盐毒性；因此，其应激反应可能比其他组织更强。
text_en: Gills can be directly exposed to various environmental stimuli, such as hypoxia and nitrite toxicity; therefore, their stress response may be stronger than that of other tissues.

quote: Ryu et al. [ 48 ] found differences in plasma levels of SOD and CAT in goldfish ( Carassius auratus ) stimulated at various light intensities, but these differences were not significant.
statement: Ryu等人发现，在不同光照强度刺激下，金鱼血浆中SOD和CAT水平存在差异，但这些差异不显著。
text_zh: Ryu等人发现，在不同光照强度刺激下，金鱼血浆中SOD和CAT水平存在差异，但这些差异不显著。
text_en: Ryu et al. found that there were differences in plasma SOD and CAT levels in goldfish under different light intensity stimuli, but these differences were not significant.

quote: Hence, various biomarkers can be measured in the plasma of fish.
statement: 因此，可以在鱼类血浆中测量各种生物标志物。
text_zh: 因此，可以在鱼类血浆中测量各种生物标志物。
text_en: Therefore, various biomarkers can be measured in fish plasma.

quote: As shown in Figure 6 , the changes in the gill, brain, kidney, and liver tissues were basically consistent, showing a trend of first decreasing, then increasing, and finally decreasing.
statement: 鳃、脑、肾脏和肝脏组织中LDH活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先下降、后上升、最后下降。
text_zh: 鳃、脑、肾脏和肝脏组织中LDH活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先下降、后上升、最后下降。
text_en: The trends in LDH activity changes in gill, brain, kidney, and liver tissues were basically consistent, showing an initial decrease, followed by an increase, and finally a decrease.

quote: The changes in the intestine and stomach tissues were basically consistent, showing a trend of first increasing, then decreasing, and finally increasing.
statement: 肠道和胃组织中LDH活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先上升、后下降、最后上升。
text_zh: 肠道和胃组织中LDH活性的变化趋势基本一致，表现为先上升、后下降、最后上升。
text_en: The trends in LDH activity changes in intestinal and gastric tissues were basically consistent, showing an initial increase, followed by a decrease, and finally an increase.

quote: When the light intensity was 18.44–21.04 lx, the LDH activity of most tissues reached a peak,
statement: 当光照强度为18.44–21.04 lx时，大多数组织的LDH活性达到峰值。
text_zh: 当光照强度为18.44–21.04 lx时，大多数组织的LDH活性达到峰值。
text_en: When light intensity is 18.44–21.04 lx, LDH activity in most tissues reaches its peak.

quote: The relative abundance of Tenericutes showed the significant difference between the two temperature groups of 18 °C and 28 °C ( p 0.05).
statement: Tenericutes的相对丰度在18°C和28°C两个水温组之间存在显著差异。
text_zh: Tenericutes的相对丰度在18°C和28°C两个水温组之间存在显著差异。
text_en: The relative abundance of Tenericutes showed a significant difference between the 18°C and 28°C water temperature groups.

quote: In the two water temperature groups, water temperature was, respectively, set at 18 °C and 28 °C, with natural daylight hours.
statement: 在两个水温组中，水温分别设定为18°C和28°C，光照时间为自然日照时长。
text_zh: 在两个水温组中，水温分别设定为18°C和28°C，光照时间为自然日照时长。
text_en: In the two water temperature groups, the water temperatures were set at 18°C and 28°C respectively, with the light duration being the natural daylight length.

quote: Heating rods were used to control ambient water temperature.
statement: 使用加热棒来控制环境温度。
text_zh: 使用加热棒来控制环境温度。
text_en: Use a heating rod to control the ambient temperature.

quote: The fish were anesthetized and then euthanized.
statement: 鱼被麻醉后实施安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼被麻醉后实施安乐死。
text_en: Fish were euthanized after being anesthetized.

quote: Analysis of Oxidative Stress Parameters Livers were rinsed with pre-cooled normal saline, blotted dry with filter paper, and then homogenized in a pre-chilled glass homogenizer.
statement: 通过冲洗、吸干和匀浆肝脏组织来分析氧化应激参数。
text_zh: 通过冲洗、吸干和匀浆肝脏组织来分析氧化应激参数。
text_en: Oxidative stress parameters were analyzed by rinsing, blotting dry, and homogenizing liver tissue.

quote: The abundances of antioxidant enzymes showed significant differences between the groups of 18 °C and 28 °C ( p 0.05).
statement: 不同水温组（18°C与28°C）之间抗氧化酶的丰度存在显著差异。
text_zh: 不同水温组（18°C与28°C）之间抗氧化酶的丰度存在显著差异。
text_en: There is a significant difference in the abundance of antioxidant enzymes between different water temperature groups (18°C and 28°C).

quote: In the group of 18 °C, the abundance of MDA was higher and the abundances of SOD, CAT, and GSH-Px were lower.
statement: 在18°C组中，MDA丰度较高，而SOD、CAT和GSH-Px的丰度较低。
text_zh: 在18°C组中，MDA丰度较高，而SOD、CAT和GSH-Px的丰度较低。
text_en: In the 18°C group, MDA abundance was higher, while SOD, CAT and GSH-Px abundances were lower.
outcome: 氧化损伤与抗氧化能力

quote: However, in the group of 28 °C, the abundance of MDA was lower and the abundances of SOD, CAT, and GSH-Px were higher.
statement: 然而，在28°C组中，MDA丰度较低，而SOD、CAT和GSH-Px的丰度较高。
text_zh: 然而，在28°C组中，MDA丰度较低，而SOD、CAT和GSH-Px的丰度较高。
text_en: However, in the 28°C group, MDA abundance was lower, while SOD, CAT and GSH-Px abundances were higher.
outcome: 氧化损伤与抗氧化能力

quote: The 18 °C group exhibited significantly higher ACE and Chao1 indices compared to the 28 °C group ( p 0.05).
statement: 与28°C组相比，18°C组的ACE和Chao1指数显著更高。
text_zh: 与28°C组相比，18°C组的ACE和Chao1指数显著更高。
text_en: Compared to the 28°C group, the ACE and Chao1 indices were significantly higher in the 18°C group.

quote: Regarding community diversity, there were still no significant differences among the light treatment groups, while in water temperature groups, the 18 °C group showed significantly higher Simpson and Shannon indices ( p 0.05).
statement: 关于群落多样性，光照处理组之间仍无显著差异，而在水温组中，18°C组的Simpson和Shannon指数显著更高。
text_zh: 关于群落多样性，光照处理组之间仍无显著差异，而在水温组中，18°C组的Simpson和Shannon指数显著更高。
text_en: Regarding community diversity, there was still no significant difference among light treatment groups, while in the water temperature groups, the Simpson and Shannon indices were significantly higher in the 18°C group.

quote: Therefore, in-depth investigation into the mechanisms through which light and temperature affect the physiological health of mandarin fish is a critical scientific issue that must be addressed to achieve healthy and efficient aquaculture.
statement: 深入研究光和温度影响鳜鱼生理健康的机制是实现健康高效养殖的关键科学问题。
text_zh: 深入研究光和温度影响鳜鱼生理健康的机制是实现健康高效养殖的关键科学问题。
text_en: In-depth research on the mechanisms by which light and temperature affect the physiological health of mandarin fish is a key scientific issue for achieving healthy and efficient aquaculture.
